items.title: 60499_Garvin Bushell oral history interview
items.q: I happened to be in the car with the white man... 'That's my brother. That's Charlie Post.'

ctx.x: All coming from -- the same music, same

music. And speaking about that way of life, I went to play with the Post family in South Carolina. They were a very rich people who conditioned race horses, you send your horses down there to be conditioned. It's an old southern family. And there were two fellows who met us at the train -- this was with Lucky Roberts and there were about five -- four or five of us to play his New Year's gig down there. Just for one night. Two fellows -- one was a mulatto sort of Negro and the other was a white man. So, I happened…
Well, we were saying, that's their way of life (unintelligible)
